title: [GMCP 203.039.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Server supervision and lifecycle orchestration
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-039-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: A durable supervisor starts servers in dependency order, health-checks readiness and liveness, applies bounded restart/backoff/quarantine, drains and reloads without losing admitted work, propagates cancellation, reaps process trees and exposes exact state/reason. Boot storms, crash loops, hangs, upgrades, resource exhaustion and host restart converge automatically without duplicate instances or silent capability loss. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
